sentences.text: Francois Jackow, born in 1969, has been chief executive officer of Air Liquide since June 1, 2022 and is a member of the group's board of directors, with his current term running to 2030.

sentences.quote: A graduate from the Ecole normale superieure of Paris, he also holds a Master's degree in Chemistry from Harvard University in the United States and an MBA from the College des ingenieurs. He joined the Air Liquide Group in 1993.

sentences.quote: Francois Jackow worked initially in the United States and the Netherlands in various positions in business development and marketing in Large Industries and in Engineering & Construction.
sentences.text: He worked initially in the United States and the Netherlands in business development and marketing roles, became vice president of innovation in 2002, then president and CEO of Air Liquide Japan in 2007 and vice president of the Large Industries world business line in 2011.

mgmt_recent.text: At the Annual General Meeting of May 5, 2026, the board kept the roles of chairman and chief executive separate and renewed Benoit Potier as Chairman of the Board and Francois Jackow as Chief Executive Officer, while Philippe Dubrulle's term as director representing the employees ended and Benjamin Le Creurer took up that role for four years. Within the executive committee, Matthieu Giard has led Group Transformation and the artificial intelligence task force since January 2026. On October 5, 2026, management unveiled "BEYOND", a strategic plan through 2030 aimed at expanding in the highest-potential markets, with a first-ever 4 billion euro buyback over 2027-2028, about 10% annual recurring EPS growth and a 400 to 600 basis point margin improvement.
